#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int calculate(const std::string& s) {
    int length = s.size();
    int p = 0;
    if (s[0] != '0') p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < length - 2; ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            p *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
        }
    }
    int p1 = 0;
    if (s[length - 1] == '_' && s[length - 2] == '_') {
        p1 = (length == 2) ? 3 : 4;
    } else if (s[length - 1] == '_') {
        if (s[length - 2] == '0' || s[length - 2] == '5' || s[length - 2] == '2' || s[length - 2] == '7') {
            p1 = 1;
        }
    } else if (s[length - 2] == '_') {
        if (s[length - 1] == '0') {
            p1 = (length == 2) ? 1 : 2;
        } else if (s[length - 1] == '5') {
            p1 = 2;
        }
    } else {
        int val = std::stoi(s.substr(length - 2));
        if (val % 25 == 0) p1 = 1;
    }
    return p * p1;
}

int main() {
    int T = 1;
    while (T-- > 0) {
        std::string s;
        std::cin >> s;
        if (s.length() == 1) {
            if (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') {
                std::cout << 1 << std::endl;
            } else {
                std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
            }
        } else {
            bool containsX = false;
            for (char c : s) {
                if (c == 'X') {
                    containsX = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!containsX) {
                std::cout << calculate(s) << std::endl;
            } else {
                int totalSum = 0;
                for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
                    std::string chArr = s;
                    for (size_t j = 0; j < s.size(); ++j) {
                        if (chArr[j] == 'X') {
                            chArr[j] = static_cast<char>(digit + '0');
                        }
                    }
                    totalSum += calculate(chArr);
                }
                std::cout << totalSum << std::endl;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
